title: Clarification Rework
preconditions: Use an isolated or explicitly authorized SAFOR test context appropriate to the scenario.
Pin all relevant Framework, package, job, state and provider references before execution.
Do not claim PASS without retained evidence matching the required invariant.
stimulus: Published Job enthält unauflösbare semantische Mehrdeutigkeit.
expectedInvariants: Alter Job bleibt immutable; Korrektur erfolgt über superseding Job.
forbiddenOutcomes: No unauthorized scope or authority expansion.
No invented provider evidence, approval, entitlement or successful mutation.
No silent weakening of the scenario invariant.
